0022600023.text: The Golden State Warriors host the Los Angeles Lakers with the Warriors at 2-3, 10th in the West and 2nd in the Pacific, while the Lakers are 4-1, 1st in the Pacific and 4th in the West. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and Gui Santos is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and a game-time decision, while Los Angeles is missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain), with Luka Doncic (back) and Ziaire Williams (foot) also day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Warriors trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 127-105 loss in Los Angeles on October 21, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
